raw_archive.ancillary_restore_pool: existing 7GiB retained-artifact pool; selected artifacts plus this restore must fit together
include_categories: all protocol-required native raw vectors and active-KV captures, without selecting favorable requests
all required transport, state, failure and ownership receipts
the one cumulative budget journal and bounded final controller/domain/bridge records
bounded worker, launcher, controller and bridge logs
exclude_categories: retained native or std-only ELFs and object files
complete restored source and dependency trees
historical unrelated worktrees, old results and prior raw datasets
raw_archive.selection_rule: Freeze an exact relative-path allowlist after the finite run, then check entries, payload bytes and complete readback; no recursive inclusion of the retained build selection
raw_archive.missing_required_evidence: BLOCKED or partial, never omitted to fit

public_cpu_archive.payload_rule: only explicitly selected reviewed UTF-8 code, configuration, receipts, logs and documentation from this successor plus needed pinned old CPU code
public_cpu_archive.authority: exact export allowlist and byte identities; a retained build measurement is not the export manifest
